description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Water 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Resist Fire 10% (15s)], [Torrential Bond] and [Sympathy Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Water 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Torrential Bond
description.text: Grants [Resist Fire 10% (15s)] after using three of Waterga Strike Barrage or Riptide Flurry

description.name: Sympathy Mode
description.text: Water abilities deal 10/20/30% more damage if the character has [Resist Fire 10/20/30+%], cast speed x1.50/x2.00/x3.00 for Water abilities if the character has [Resist Fire 10/20/30+%], removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]
